description: This Java class defines a data entity 'ClobDatatypeStorage' used within the OpenMRS API to store large string values (CLOBs). It extends the base OpenMRS object and includes fields for ID and value, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ClobDatatypeStorage
classes.description: Represents a storage entity for large string data, marked as audited for change tracking, inheriting from the base OpenMRS object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this storage entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this storage entity.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the stored large string value.
